verdict.rationale: Driver openness is a fair axis for a GPU, but nothing in the evidence pack documents open-source kernel modules or upstream Linux driver support for the H200. The only 'open source' mention is a 5G/6G communications research library, which is not a driver and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run this GPU on an open driver — open-source kernel modules or upstream Linux support documented by the vendor
